Rolling gives 2 FTs in GW3 to attack the real structural problem (no Haaland, ~111 EO) with real 26/27 minutes data instead of a preseason-corrupted xPts file. Market-desk confirms zero price pressure on any squad player, so there is no cost to waiting.

rejected_alternative.why: Mendy's 16.42 xPts is a confirmed model artifact (sim-lab: absent from features.json entirely, zero cumulative record, projected above Haaland's 6.43; 5 of the top 6 xPts rows are cheap promoted-side defenders). Buying a bench defender off a broken projection burns a FT for a like-for-like bench slot. If the manager insists on clearing Palestra, do it as a cash-freeing swap to a nailed cheap defender - never as a captaincy play.

risks.detail: Forced off late vs Liverpool after collision with Nunez. No formal FPL flag, not named in Arteta's 27 Aug presser, and news-desk has him in the predicted ARS XI at CB (Saliba/Timber both out increases his importance). Medical-bay holds him at 90%. ACTION: re-check Arsenal team news before the 17:30 UTC deadline; if he is flagged, promote van Ewijk into the XI and move the armband's backup to Semenyo (202 cum_pts, next in the locked ranking).

Only 4 of 15 squad players have an xPts row, and the top of the pool is dominated by 4.0m promoted-side defenders. Ranking and captaincy this week are driven by season cum_pts (locked protocol) and sim-lab Monte Carlo EV, not by xpts.json. Projected xPts uses mc_ev as the per-player proxy.
69.3% owned, ~42% captained, ~111 EO. Every Haaland return is effectively doubled against this squad. This is a transfer problem, not a captain problem - it is the reason the FT is being rolled.
